## The "go" package manager adapter

See ../../app/manifest_adapters/manifest_adapters/go_mod/adapter.rb
for the manifest adapter, which reads go.mod files.
The Go code lives in ../../go/ecosystem/go/gopma.

### Running the adapter

Run the adapter with `package_manager_adapters/script/start go`

### Running the tests

Run adapter tests with `package_manager_adapters/script/test go`
